EN: Welcome to our humble abode.
ZH: 欢迎光临寒舍。

EN: Can we offer you anything? Biscuits? Radioactive smoothie?
ZH: 想吃点什么吗？饼干？辐射奶昔？

EN: It does wonders for the skin.
ZH: 它会对皮肤产生神奇的作用。

EN: I'm afraid you guys have to vacate the premises.
ZH: 我恐怕你们得清空一下地基了。

EN: You know there's an abandoned Vault a few miles North, right?
ZH: 在往北几公里的地方有一个废弃的避难所，你知道吗？

EN: Sure, but maybe you want to look inside this gun's barrel first?
ZH: 当然，但也许你应该先看看这把枪管里装的啥吧？

EN: The big day is almost upon us. The idea was to have a wedding in a natural setting, but since it's too dangerous outside we'll use a nearby cave instead. We just need to sterilize it.
ZH: 激动人心的日子就要到来了。我们的想法是在自然的背景下举行一场婚礼，但外面太危险了，我们改用附近的一处洞穴，只需简单清理消毒一下就行。

EN: A Labor of Love
ZH: 爱的劳动

EN: Eliminate the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Clear out a cave in preparation for a wedding.
ZH: 清空一个洞穴，为婚礼做准备。

EN: This cave ain't big enough for the both of us!
ZH: 这个洞穴根本装不下我们俩！

EN: We're headed to Vault 120... They were the stars of the latest edition of the New Boston Bugle...
ZH: 我们正在前往120号避难所……他们是最新一期新波士顿号角报的明星……

EN: No idea, I was just a worker in the diner. Maybe the Overseer of 120 will know?
ZH: 不认识，我只是在餐厅工作的员工。也许120号避难所的监督者知道？

EN: Thank the heavens! You've saved us from those filthy Raiders!
ZH: 谢天谢地！是你们把我们从这些讨厌的掠夺者手中救了出来！

EN: We did everything we could but they found us and brought a huge force!
ZH: 我们做了一切我们能做的，但他们还是找到了我们，并带来了一大帮人。

EN: I've never seen anything like it...
ZH: 我从未见过这样的事……

EN: The Overseer... She's DEAD! She led the defense and was the first to be cut down.
ZH: 监督者……她死了！她带领我们顽强抵抗，却最先被杀死。

EN: What are you going to do now?
ZH: 你现在准备怎么办？

EN: Do you know who is publishing the Bugle?
ZH: 你知道谁是号角报的发行者吗？

EN: The Overseer of 404 appears to have a way to get in contact with the publisher of the New Boston Bugle. She's our ticket to stardom!
ZH: 404号避难所的监督者似乎有办法和新波士顿号角报的发行者取得联系。她是我们成为明星的希望！

EN: A Map to the Stars
ZH: 成名之路

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404.
ZH: 和404号避难所的监督者交谈。

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404 about the New Bugle.
ZH: 和404号避难所的监督者讨论关于新号角报的事。

EN: Wrong. They're pretty loud, and they usually won't heal you.
ZH: 错了。它们相当吵闹，而且它们通常不会治疗你。

EN: Yes indeed! Sweet, sweet radiation. Here, you deserve this.
ZH: 确实是的！美妙，多么美妙的辐射。这是你应得的。

EN: Nope. He makes that little eerie music when he shows up, remember?
ZH: 不。当他出现的时候，他会发出奇怪的音乐，记得吗？

EN: Oh well, maybe next time!
ZH: 噢好吧，也许下一次！

EN: Oh, hello. Have you come to look for parts?
ZH: 噢你好。你来找零件的吗？

EN: We have some we're willing to let go...if you can answer this riddle!
ZH: 我们手里有一些可以转让的……如果你能回答这个谜语！

EN: “Some fear me, some seek me. I may change you, or I may heal you.”
ZH: “有些人惧怕我，有些人追寻我。我可以改变你，也可以治愈你。”

EN: “I'm always around, yet I don't make a sound. Who am I?”
ZH: “我常在你身旁，但我不作声响。我是谁？”

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel?
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会？

EN: Ionizing radiation?
ZH: 电离辐射？

EN: The Mysterious Stranger?
ZH: 神秘陌生人？

EN: I don't know, and I don't care.
ZH: 不知道，也不关心。

EN: One of your dwellers has come across a relatively untouched Red Rocket. Maybe there's some valuable junk inside!
ZH: 一个你们的居民遇见了个几乎未动过的红火箭。也许里面有些值钱的东西！

EN: A Nice Ghoul Like You
ZH: 像你这样的好尸鬼

EN: Deal with a group of testy Ghouls.
ZH: 对付一群暴躁的尸鬼。

EN: Check out a Red Rocket fueling station for parts.
ZH: 在红火箭加油站里寻找零件。

EN: This doesn't seem much like a Vault to me. Are you sure we have the right place?
ZH: 在我看来这个不太像个避难所，你确定这是正确的位置吗？

EN: Ah well, I tried! Get 'em!
ZH: 啊好吧，至少我试过了！给我拿下他们！

EN: This is more like it!
ZH: 这才像话！

EN: Huh, really? Maybe you should go speak to the Overseer then.
ZH: 哈，真的吗？也许你应该和监督者谈谈。

EN: Well, the Overseer did say to try talking to outsiders first. He's down the hall.
ZH: 好吧，监督者确实说过先和外面的人谈谈。他在大厅里。

EN: Anyone who wants to see the Overseer has to go through me!
ZH: 任何想要见监督者的人都得先过我这一关！

EN: I mean, not literal-like. Just, you know...
ZH: 我是说，不是字面上说的那种，就是，你知道的……

EN: Gosh, being all civilized is tough! Maybe Vault life ain't for me?
ZH: 天，想变成一个文明人可真难！也许避难所生活不适合我？

EN: Bring it! I'm ready for a fight!
ZH: 上吧！我已经准备好了！

EN: I've already beaten up most of your guys. What's one or two more?
ZH: 我已经打败你们大多数人了。再多一两个人又怎么样？

EN: I'm from a real Vault! You've got it all wrong!
ZH: 我真的是来自避难所的！你们都搞错了！

EN: Wait, maybe we can do this without any more fighting.
ZH: 等等，也许我们能和平解决这个问题。

EN: Oh, great! And uh... can we just forget this place ever existed?
ZH: 哦，真棒！而且呃……我们能不能忘了这个地方存在过？

EN: Oh... I guess I'll just wander then. Probably get eaten alive out there. No worries! Bye forever!
ZH: 哦……我想我就随便逛逛吧。说不定就在外面被生吞活剥了。不用担心！永别了！

EN: Hey, an actual Vault Dweller! Uh, I really thought this here Vault thing was going to work out.
ZH: 嘿，一位真正的避难所居民！呃，我真的以为在这里所谓的“避难所”能起作用。

EN: But, I think I maybe attracted the wrong crowd for it.
ZH: 但是，我想我可能吸引了错误的目标群。

EN: And it really isn't anything like a real Vault, is it?
ZH: 而且这真的一点儿也不像真正的避难所，对吧？

EN: Can I just join your Vault instead?
ZH: 能不能干脆让我加入你们的避难所？

EN: Sure thing! Glad to have you aboard!
ZH: 当然！很高兴你能成为我们的一员！

EN: No way! You've caused enough trouble!
ZH: 没门儿！你闯的祸已经够多了！

EN: There's a new Vault in the Wasteland, and it's run by Raiders! Vault-Tec is long gone, so who could have possibly constructed Vault R41D? Time to investigate...
ZH: 在废土上有一个新避难所，是掠夺者管理的！避难所科技早已不复存在，那又会是谁修建了 R41D 号避难所呢？赶紧去调查吧。

EN: A Pale Imitation
ZH: 拙劣的模仿

EN: Confront the Overseer.
ZH: 和监督者对峙。

EN: Confront Vault R41D's Raider Boss.
ZH: 和R41D号避难所的掠夺者首领对峙。

EN: Investigate a mysterious, brand new Vault.
ZH: 调查一个神秘的全新避难所。

EN: Hey! Someone found the Vault, and they ain't got no invitation!
ZH: 嘿！有人找到了那个避难所，他们可不接受不请自来的人！

EN: Boss said no new blood 'til we're ready to open the Vault. Kill them!
ZH: 老大说在我们还没有准备好公开避难所之前不允许新人加入，给我杀了他们！

EN: Look, I'm not really a Raider, but I gotta kill ya if I want to stay here. So... Die!
ZH: 看，我不是一个真的掠夺者，但如果我想继续待在这儿的话就得杀了你。所以……去死吧！

EN: This is our Vault! You're not welcome here!
ZH: 这是我们的避难所！这里不欢迎你！

EN: Raiders captured and attempted to domesticate a Deathclaw. It did not go well. They all need to die.
ZH: 掠夺者们抓住了一只死爪，试图驯服它，但并不成功。他们都得死。

EN: A Poorly Thought-Out Plan
ZH: 一个欠考虑的计划

EN: Eliminate the Raider Leader.
ZH: 除掉掠夺者首领。

EN: Destroy the Deathclaw.
ZH: 除掉死爪。

EN: Kill the Raiders and their Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者和他们的死爪。

EN: I knew taming Deathclaws was a bad idea!
ZH: 我就知道驯服死爪不是什么好主意！

EN: First the Deathclaw, now Dwellers? This is not my day.
ZH: 先是死爪，然后是居民？这是什么鬼日子！

EN: So, you're the one trying to take what's rightfully mine.
ZH: 所以，你就是那个想夺走本该属于我的东西的人。

EN: The only way you're getting Bottle & Cappy is by going through me first!
ZH: 想得到瓶瓶和盖盖，就得先过我这一关！

EN: Gosh, are we glad you showed up! Those Raiders were pretty scary.
ZH: 天，幸好你出现了！那些掠夺者真吓人。

EN: To thank you for saving us, we'll visit your Vault once in a while and bring your Dwellers a little bit of Nuka-fun.
ZH: 为了报答你救了我们，我们会偶尔拜访你的避难所，给你的居民们带一些核子可乐。

EN: Oh, I can't wait! See you soon!
ZH: 哦，我等不及了！再见！

EN: A stranger at the RobCo Building told me the Raiders took Bottle & Cappy to the Nuka-Cola Factory. I have a feeling I'll finally catch up to them this time.
ZH: 罗伯科大楼里的一个陌生人告诉我，掠夺者把瓶瓶和盖盖带去了核子可乐工厂。我有种预感，这次终于能追上它们了。

EN: A Refreshing Rescue
ZH: 令人振奋的救援行动

EN: Rescue Bottle & Cappy from the Raiders!
ZH: 从掠夺者手中拯救瓶瓶和盖盖！

EN: Rescue Bottle & Cappy from the Nuka-Cola Factory.
ZH: 从核子可乐工厂中拯救瓶瓶和盖盖。

EN: There's a Glowing One I saw somewhere around here. Look out for her.
ZH: 我在这附近见过一只发光种。小心提防她。

EN: There's a bunch of supplies in the Manager's Office if you haven't found it yet. Might be something useful.
ZH: 经理办公室里有很多物资，可以找找看，说不定有些能用。

EN: “Protect the people at a minute's notice.” That was the idea.
ZH: “团结起来，义务保护人民。”这是最初的想法。

EN: Man, I don't know who you are, but your timing's impeccable.
ZH: 兄弟，我不知道你们是谁，但你们来得太是时候了。

EN: Preston Garvey, Commonwealth Minutemen.
ZH: 我叫普雷斯顿·加维，联邦义勇军民兵组织的成员。

EN: I came here to search for supplies when these ghouls got the drop on me.
ZH: 我来到这里，寻找物资。结果让尸鬼抢先了。

EN: I'm ready to go whenever you are!
ZH: 只要你们准备好了，我随时可以走！

EN: Any bad guys I should look out for around here?
ZH: 这附近有没有需要我们提防的坏蛋？

EN: Find anything useful in here?
ZH: 找到什么有用的东西了吗？

EN: Minutemen?
ZH: 义勇军？

EN: Minuteman Preston Garvey has gotten himself stuck in the Kendall Hospital surrounded by Feral Ghouls and who knows what else. Save him!
ZH: 义勇军民兵普雷斯顿·加维被困在肯德尔医院了，医院被狂尸鬼和不知道是什么的可怕东西包围了，快救他！

EN: A Settler Needs Your Help
ZH: 有人需要你的帮助

EN: Find Preston Garvey in Kendall Hospital.
ZH: 在肯德尔医院找到普雷斯顿·加维。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Loot the manager's office.
ZH: 搜刮经理办公室。

EN: Find Preston Garvey in the Kendall Hospital.
ZH: 在肯德尔医院找到了普雷斯顿·加维。

EN: A Settler Needs Your Help
ZH: 有人需要你的帮助

EN: The one you traded for your friend Jack? As dowry? Talk to Krant - he's got what you came for.
ZH: 就是你们为了朋友杰克换出去的那只？当嫁妆的那只？和科兰特聊聊吧，他手里有你们想要的东西。

EN: Ha! I remember you, but I bet you don't remember me!
ZH: 哈！我记得你，但我打赌你肯定不记得我！

EN: You were on a different planet. You still alien gods? Whatever. You guys are a hoot.
ZH: 你曾在一个不同的星球上。你们还是外星人上帝吗？无所谓。你们这些人真是搞笑。

EN: Did Glenda end up killing a Radscorpion with her bare fists? She's always been a big talker.
ZH: 格兰达最终徒手杀死了辐射蝎吗？她总是喜欢说大话。

EN: I suppose you came here for your pet?
ZH: 我猜你是为了你们的宠物而来的？

EN: Our pet?
ZH: 我们的宠物？

EN: Oh yeah, he's alive and married to Kaela. Her crew is over at a cave east of here.
ZH: 哦对，他还活着，和凯拉结婚了，她的队员在东边的一个山洞里。

EN: I've got your pet, but I think you got the worst of the bargain.
ZH: 你们的宠物在我手上，不过我觉得这笔买卖亏的可是你们。

EN: Your boy Jack didn't look particularly happy when he woke up this morning.
ZH: 你们的孩子杰克今早起来的时候看上去并不是很高兴。

EN: We Raiders don't do wedding rings... The couple brands each other.
ZH: 我们掠夺者才不搞结婚戒指那一套……这对夫妇互相给对方烙上印记。

EN: Nice scar, though. Looked like it'll heal well.
ZH: 不过疤痕不错，看上去会恢复得很好。

EN: Jack's still alive? Then we might live to see another day, too...
ZH: 杰克还活着？我们还有可能再多活一天……

EN: Last night, we ended up partying with Raiders at an old Warehouse. We should search there for clues to Jack's whereabouts. He's the Overseer's son, after all. If we lose him, we'll end up getting kicked out of the Vault with nothing on our backs... or worse!
ZH: 昨晚，我们在旧仓库和掠夺者们一起开了个派对。我们应该搜索那边，找到关于杰克去向的线索。毕竟他是监督者的儿子。如果我们弄丢了他，就会被赶出避难所、落得一无所有……甚至更惨！

EN: A Special Brand
ZH: 一个特殊的品牌

EN: Find out if the Raiders know what happened to Jack.
ZH: 探探掠夺者的口风，看看他们是否知道杰克的下落。

EN: We were partying at an old Warehouse! Maybe there are clues there...
ZH: 我们在旧仓库里开派对！也许那边会有线索……

EN: Oh sure! Nice lady. The Ferals dragged her away, to some abandoned building.
ZH: 哦当然！很不错的女士。狂尸鬼把她拖到了某个废弃建筑里。

EN: Phew! You folks saved my bacon! Those Feral Ghouls are no joke!
ZH: 真是松了口气。你们救了我的命！那些狂尸鬼可真不是开玩笑的！

EN: Artie, Artie Moore. Explorer, scavenger, all around awesome guy.
ZH: 阿蒂，阿蒂·摩尔。探险家、拾荒者，还是个全能大牛。

EN: Have you seen Paula Plumbkin?
ZH: 你有见过宝拉·普朗布金吗？

EN: Paula Plumbkin wasn't at Vault 730, but a helpful Raider told you she set out for the old Nuka-Cola plant. Go track her down!
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金不在730号避难所，但一个掠夺者告诉你她出发去核子可乐工厂了。快去找她吧！

EN: A Thirst for Adventure
ZH: 探险渴望者

EN: Explore the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 探索核子可乐工厂。

EN: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 沿着宝拉·普朗布金走过的路进入到旧的核子可乐工厂。

EN: A Wasteland Tail
ZH: 废土踪迹

EN: Another note on the ground! Let me guess: It's from Coach...
ZH: 地上又有记号，让我猜猜。我觉得是教练留下的。

EN: “All right, I've got to give you Dwellers credit.
ZH: 好吧，我得承认，你们这些居民确实有两下子。

EN: The Wasteland has thrown everything at you, and still you press on!
ZH: 废土丢了个大烂摊子给你，但你仍然勇往直前！

EN: But you're still not getting Jobinson's Jersey! - Coach”
ZH: “但是你们仍然不可能得到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！”——教练

EN: We have word that a fierce Alpha Deathclaw has taken up residence in an old office building. Maybe it killed Coach! Dare to dream, right?
ZH: 据说一只凶猛的领头死爪占领了一幢旧的办公楼。也许它杀了教练！它还真的做得出来！

EN: A Winning Season
ZH: 胜利的赛季

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Did an Alpha Deathclaw take Coach out?
ZH: 是不是那只领头死爪干掉了教练？

EN: You may have made it this far, but now you're done!
ZH: 虽然你们已经做了这么多，但现在你们完蛋了！

EN: Once I'm through with you, I'm gonna start a new, better gang!
ZH: 等这次结束了，我一定会重新建立一个新的，更好的小队！

EN: Maybe the “Fancy 55”... Whatever, you're dead!
ZH: 也许是“华丽55”吧……不管怎么样，你已经死了。

EN: Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it takes?
ZH: 好吧，也许77太夸张了，但他们那么多人，而你就一个。你有那么大本事吗？

EN: Against The Odds
ZH: 背水一战

EN: Kill the Psycho 77's leader.
ZH: 消灭“疯子77”的首领。

EN: Wipe out the Psycho 77.
ZH: 除掉“疯子77”。

EN: You'll never defeat all of us!
ZH: 你是不可能打败我们所有人的！

EN: Our gang is unstoppable!
ZH: 我们小队所向披靡！

EN: Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing lab coats!
ZH: 是时候去对付更聪明的目标了：狂尸鬼！说到聪明——你还得穿着实验服去干！

EN: Aim for the Head!
ZH: 瞄准脑袋！

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Super Duper Mart! This place has everything!
ZH: 大无敌超市！这里应有尽有！

EN: Here are a few things that should work, but it's not enough.
ZH: 这些东西还凑合，但远远不够。

EN: Gather it up and let's keep looking!
ZH: 赶紧收集起来，我们继续找！

EN: There are logs on this computer; sales and inventory. Maybe there's a clue here?
ZH: 这台电脑上有日志，里头是销售和库存记录。也许这里有线索？

EN: Figured it would be bigger.
ZH: 我以为这地方会更大一点呢。

EN: Here we are! Uncle Sam's house!
ZH: 我们到了！政府大楼！

EN: They were hiding more than streamers and balloons.
ZH: 他们藏着的可不止是气球和彩带。

EN: Really? You're still locked in on the party hats?
ZH: 真是的，你难道还要找派对帽子吗？

EN: Woah look at all these computers!
ZH: 哇，看这儿有这么多电脑！

EN: Finally! Here's the stuff! Doesn't look like they got a chance to decorate.
ZH: 终于！找到了！看起来他们根本没来得及把装饰挂起来。

EN: We got what we came for. Let's go home.
ZH: 我们要找的东西都找到了。走吧，回家！

EN: I'm pretty sure we just found a dead alien.
ZH: 我敢肯定我们刚发现了一只死外星人。

EN: Hey! I just found a package of balloons! It's still sealed!
ZH: 嘿！我找到了一包气球！还是密封的！

EN: We're in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
ZH: 毕竟是末世废土，也很正常。

EN: Is it just me or is this place really spooky.
ZH: 这地方真诡异，你觉得呢？

EN: Yeah, I know. And THIS is what's creeping me out.
ZH: 我知道，但就是这个让我心里发毛。

EN: Looks like they ran security here. I doubt we'll find any locked doors in this place.
ZH: 看起来他们对这里的安保下了不少功夫，我觉得应该不会直接给门上锁的。

EN: People here must have left in a hurry.
ZH: 这里的人一定走得很匆忙。

EN: You were right. All the doors are open.
ZH: 你说的没错，所有门都开着。

EN: Whatever they were, they are way friendlier dead. Let's get out of here!
ZH: 不管他们是什么，死了就友善多了。我们快走吧！

EN: ALIENS?!
ZH: 外星人！？

EN: They're aliens.
ZH: 他们是外星人。

EN: What the hell were those guys?
ZH: 这些家伙到底是什么？

EN: Ok now I'm freaking out!
ZH: 太吓人了！

EN: <Unintelligible language>
ZH: <无法理解的语言>

EN: There has to be more than that, though. How did they get here?
ZH: 但肯定不止这些。他们怎么会来到这里的？

EN: There were rumors for years before the bombs fell. Looks like they were true.
ZH: 在炸弹落下之前的几年里，一直有传言。看来传言是真的。

EN: This tech they've got is wild! Did you see their guns? PEW PEW!
ZH: 他们的科技真疯狂！你看到他们的枪了吗？咻！咻！

EN: So apparently there is an "object" somewhere at this "crash site."
ZH: 据说“坠毁现场”有个“东西”。

EN: Looks like a cave.
ZH: 看起来像个洞穴。

EN: It's a cave.
ZH: 是个洞穴。

EN: Another one of those things!
ZH: 又是一个那种东西！

EN: There's an id tag here... RobCo?
ZH: 还有个身份标签……罗伯科公司？
